rules: No migration is assumed from shared contracts alone.
During phased convergence the ledger is the authority for which repository currently owns a migrated responsibility.
A migration is not complete until destination evidence passes and the old authority is reconciled or intentionally retained with a documented compatibility bridge.
Rollback must be defined before moving a stateful or production responsibility.
A PLANNED entry is a documented candidate, not permission to copy/move code. MIGRATE_NOW authorizes only the explicitly bounded scope and preserves source authority until destination acceptance.
